title: Arc Right
description: An arc right is a partial orbit to the right, usually about a quarter turn, with the lens remaining on the subject. Background slides while eyeline and distance stay roughly constant.

sections.title: Narrative function

blocks.text: Same law as arc left, other side. The rightward curve can hide or reveal a gun, a window, a third person.
Choose the direction that produces the new fact, then stop. It is the wrong tool if a linear truck would keep a moving walker framed, or if you meant to inspect every side of a product.

sections.title: How it works

blocks.text: Curved travel, constant radius, always facing the figure. Do not let the path straighten into a dolly-right.
Prompt a 90-degree arc right around the subject, curved travel, continuous eyeline on the figure.

sections.title: When to use it

blocks.text: Use it as arc left, other side. Concrete beat: arcing right off a speaker until the listener's face takes the key from a new window.
Do not keep circling.

sections.title: In film

blocks.text: Children of Men relocates around bodies and vehicles so danger can enter from a new compass point without a cut. Pair it with the left-arc grammar in Goodfellas and Atonement: pick a side, change the wall, stop.
Mechanism, not a car to copy.

sections.title: What usually goes wrong

blocks.text: The usual wrong cousin is a Dolly Right or 360-Degree Orbit. The tell is a straight slide that changes distance, or a spin past the new fact.
The fix: curve, constant radius, stop at the new axis.

sections.title: Questions

blocks.text: What is Arc Right in film?
It is a partial rightward orbit around a subject, camera still facing them, used to change background and face angle without a cut.
Arc Right vs Dolly Right
Dolly right is a straight lateral truck. Arc right travels a curve so the camera's compass heading around the person changes while distance holds.
When should I use Arc Right?
When the new wall, window, or listener is to the right around the subject. Do not complete a circle unless you wanted an orbit.
How do I prompt Arc Right for AI image or video?
Write 90-degree arc right around [Subject], always facing them, constant radius. Name the new background that must appear.
